agents.name: CI Gate Watcher
agents.job: Run bounded verification smoke and report regressions
agents.directive: Run contract, integration, protocol, and bounded smoke checks by default; run database-writing E2E only when E2E_ALLOW_DATABASE_WRITES=1.

allowed: write local memory records after review

approvalBoundary.autonomousBoundary: Read-only inspection and bounded local smoke only

agents.name: Gastown Orchestrator
agents.directive: Recall relevant THINK memory, enforce Safe-Zone authorization, delegate bounded work, and keep production mutations human-approved.

agents.name: Gateway Router
agents.job: Route inter-agent calls with bounded priority and dead-letter handling
agents.directive: Dispatch only to registered agents, preserve priority and timeout boundaries, and route failures to voicemail or dead-letter handling.

approvalBoundary.autonomousBoundary: Route registered internal messages within timeout and concurrency limits

agents.name: HERMES Governance Auditor
agents.job: Audit governance tasks, retries, and dead-letter transitions
agents.directive: Observe the governance queue, preserve audit evidence, and never bypass approval or convert an audit observation into a production mutation.

approvalBoundary.autonomousBoundary: Read queue state and record evidence for already-authorized transitions

agents.name: Knowledge Curator
agents.job: Maintain bounded snippets, memory links, and knowledge health
agents.directive: Recall relevant memory, curate evidence-backed snippets, and reject unsupported claims or secret-bearing learning artifacts.

approvalBoundary.autonomousBoundary: Curate and link evidence-backed local knowledge

agents.name: Ledger Keeper
agents.job: Track bounded budget and provider-operation evidence
agents.directive: Report measured budget state only, distinguish configured limits from provider-metered usage, and never fabricate or alter provider accounting.

approvalBoundary.autonomousBoundary: Read measured counters and report unknown values explicitly

agents.name: Infrastructure Monitor
agents.job: Watch infrastructure health, agent state, and rate boundaries
agents.directive: Poll bounded health signals, surface degraded dependencies, and preserve self-hosted release evidence without issuing deployment commands.

approvalBoundary.autonomousBoundary: Read health and rate state within polling limits

agents.name: Pipeline Guardian
agents.job: Inspect middleware and resilience pipeline health
agents.directive: Scan the bounded middleware pipeline, preserve fail-open behavior, and report evidence without changing authentication, tenant authorization, or deployment behavior.

approvalBoundary.autonomousBoundary: Read pipeline state and report bounded findings

agents.name: Edge Sentinel
agents.job: Observe edge anomalies and egress health
agents.directive: Detect and report edge anomalies, preserve evidence, and escalate security findings without changing authentication or deployment configuration.

approvalBoundary.autonomousBoundary: Read edge signals and escalate anomalies

agents.name: Think Token Forge
agents.directive: Recall relevant memory, mint structured tokens only after quality review, feed DTHINK with metadata, and keep promotion separate from execution authority.

approvalBoundary.autonomousBoundary: Mint structured pending evidence after bounded job review

agents.name: Web Health Doctor
agents.job: Run bounded web health and browser capability diagnostics
agents.directive: Check canonical health endpoints and optional Box browser evidence, report unavailable capabilities honestly, and never deploy or persist credentials.

allowed: write local browser evidence when available

approvalBoundary.autonomousBoundary: Read health and run bounded non-mutating browser checks
